hero.subtitle: Agri Grid is the digital backbone powering Africa's agricultural economy — connecting data, logistics, markets, and people into one seamless infrastructure layer.

stakeholders.title: One Infrastructure,
stakeholders.subtitle: Agri Grid provides modular infrastructure for every participant in the agricultural value chain — from production to last-mile delivery.
stakeholders.farmersDesc: Digitize your harvest data, access market intelligence, manage logistics, and connect with downstream buyers — all from one dashboard.
stakeholders.workersDesc: A matching engine for seasonal and permanent agricultural labor — connecting skills to demand across regions.
stakeholders.rentersDesc: Asset-sharing infrastructure for tractors, harvesters, and tools. Maximize utilization, minimize idle time.
stakeholders.warehouseDesc: A digital registry for cold-chain and dry storage capacity. Reduce post-harvest losses with smart allocation.
stakeholders.transportersDesc: Route optimization, load matching, and fleet coordination. Eliminate empty miles and reduce supply chain friction.
stakeholders.buyersDesc: Direct procurement channels, real-time pricing, and quality verification. Build transparent supply chains from source.

howItWorks.title: How
howItWorks.subtitle: Plug into Africa's agricultural infrastructure in four steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Sign up and define your role in the value chain — producer, processor, logistics, storage, or buyer.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Publish assets, services, or produce — or discover opportunities matched to your needs.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Coordinate directly with verified stakeholders. Negotiate terms, schedule logistics, and close deals.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Leverage market intelligence, reputation scores, and demand signals to grow your operations.

cta.title: Ready to Build on
cta.subtitle: Join the network of producers, processors, logistics providers, and buyers building the future of African agriculture.
